name: 3D MM-Vet
description: A newly human-curated benchmark designed to evaluate 3D geometry understanding and language-unified 3D interaction tasks such as embodied visual grounding, supporting the evaluation of the ShapeLLM model.
reputation: A niche but credible recent benchmark from the 3D multimodal literature, mainly used in papers on 3D LLMs and embodied grounding rather than as a broad community standard.
notes: Supports evaluation of 3D multimodal large language models for embodied interaction tasks.
